faqs.q: How does game boosting work at OGmodz?
faqs.a: OGmodz streamlines game boosting into an intuitive, transparent experience. First, you browse our live game catalog—including competitive titles like GTA V, Counter-Strike 2, Call of Duty, and Fortnite. Using our Interactive Configurator, you select your exact gaming platform (PC, PlayStation 5, or Xbox Series X|S) and choose your specific service package, such as rank progression, in-game currency, trophy unlocks, or level milestones. Once your order is placed, it is assigned immediately to a thoroughly vetted, high-ranking professional booster from our elite roster. Our specialist connects to your match or lobbies using bank-grade security protocols and country-matched VPN routing. You can follow your boost progress in real time with continuous milestone tracking and 24/7 dedicated support until your desired rank is completely delivered.

faqs.q: Is game boosting safe for my account?
faqs.a: Account security and privacy are the highest priorities at OGmodz. Every booster on our roster is under strict contractual compliance to never use bots, third-party injection scripts, cheats, or automated software of any kind. All boosting is executed 100% by hand by top-tier human players. Furthermore, our boosters utilize premium localized VPN connections that match your geographical city and IP location, ensuring game servers see only standard residential login activity. For additional peace of mind, we employ end-to-end encryption for all order credentials, operate in stealth offline mode during gameplay, and back every single purchase with a comprehensive 100% money-back guarantee and account protection policy.

faqs.q: What platforms are supported (PC, PlayStation, Xbox)?
faqs.a: OGmodz provides comprehensive multi-platform coverage across all major gaming ecosystems. For PC players, we support all prominent distribution clients, including Steam, Epic Games Store, Battle.net, and Rockstar Games Launcher. For console enthusiasts, we fully support both PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 (including next-generation Enhanced editions) as well as Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S. When configuring your order, our system automatically adapts available packages, trophy milestones, and edition-specific options to your chosen hardware, ensuring seamless compatibility and flawless execution across every supported platform.

faqs.q: How fast is delivery and order fulfillment?
faqs.a: Speed and reliability define the OGmodz standard. After completing your order, our automated dispatcher routes your request to an active booster specializing in your game, typically picking up your order within 15 to 30 minutes. Delivery timelines depend on the magnitude of the boost, but most standard rank upgrades, cash packages, and level tiers are completed within a few hours. Throughout the process, you receive status updates, and our 24/7 customer support team is always available to answer questions or schedule custom playtime windows around your personal gaming routine.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.sec1Text: By accessing or purchasing services from OGmodz, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions and all applicable laws and regulations.
terms.sec2Text: OGmodz provides digital gameplay enhancement, skill progression, and coaching services delivered by verified players. All service scopes, delivery estimates, and target ranks are defined at checkout.
terms.sec3Text: You agree to provide accurate platform and game account details. Our roster utilizes strict private VPNs and zero-injection manual gameplay. You must not access your account during active boost windows.
terms.sec4Text: All progression is executed manually by ranked players without cheats, third-party software, or botting. If a service cannot be completed as ordered, you are protected by our Money-Back Guarantee.
terms.sec5Text: For legal questions or clarifications regarding our terms, reach out to support@ogmodz.gg or through our Contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.sec1Text: We collect necessary order details including your in-game name, email address, selected platform, and boost goals required to fulfill your purchase.
privacy.sec2Text: Your information is used strictly to coordinate your order, notify you of progression updates, and provide customer support. We never sell or share your data with advertisers.
privacy.sec3Text: All communications and credential handoffs are protected by industry-standard TLS encryption. Credentials are discarded immediately upon successful service completion.
privacy.sec4Text: You have the right to request a copy of your stored order data or request complete deletion of your customer record at any time by contacting our support team.

refunds.title: Refunds & Money-Back Guarantee
refunds.sec1Text: If your order has not yet been assigned to a booster or execution has not begun, you are eligible for an immediate, no-questions-asked 100% refund.
refunds.sec2Text: If a boost is partially completed and you wish to pause or cancel, we calculate a fair pro-rata refund based strictly on the rank or division achieved up to that point.
refunds.sec3Text: If a booster fails to meet your performance standards or deadlines, we will assign a top-tier substitute immediately or refund the remaining service value.
refunds.sec4Text: Simply contact support with your order number via our Contact form or live support. Requests are reviewed and processed within 24 hours.
